seven_named_results.statement: For every finite n,positive integer t,probability pi,row-stochastic A reversible w.r.t.pi,and x_i in real l1,there exist ambient y_i satisfying fidelity+t one-step squared-l1 energy <=3024 times t-step Cesaro squared-l1 endpoint cost. N2(l1)<=12sqrt21.
seven_named_results.conditions: Dimension/coordinate/time independent;no optimized constant;zero pi_i allowed;not linear cotype,Markov type,pointwise risk or subspace-preserving smoothing.

seven_named_results.statement: Unless all x_i coincide,finite positive weights w_B,binary z_i and affine T reconstruct x_i;pair l1 distance equals weighted binary l1 distance equals Hilbert norm SQUARED;T is weighted-l1 contractive on all real cut coordinates.
seven_named_results.conditions: At most2^n-2 cut types;ambient b_B vectors retained. Infinite original coordinates not automatically finite computation;T need not stay in span of input.

seven_named_results.statement: For u,uprime in weighted cube Q and BINARY e,||Phi(uprime)-Phi(u)||1,w^2<=108*(F_e(uprime)-F_e(u)-4||u-e||H^2*<u-e,uprime-u>H),F_e=||u-e||H^4,Phi(r)=3r^2-2r^3.
seven_named_results.conditions: Bounded cube and binary center essential;not arbitrary real or simplex map.

seven_named_results.statement: Q-valued finite-dimensional H martingale converging a.s.;e is F0-measurable binary. Sum expected squared Phi increments <=108*(E terminal quartic-E initial quartic)<=108 E terminal quartic.
seven_named_results.conditions: Center may depend on initial state. Bounded convergence for potential and monotone convergence for nonnegative jump series;no generic unbounded martingale assertion.

seven_named_results.statement: For any stationary finite Markov chain and metric data,S independent with P(S=s)=p q^s,s>=0,p=1/(t+1),q=t/(t+1),t>=1;E d(XS,X0)^2 <=(28/t)*sum_s=1^t E d(Xs,X0)^2.
seven_named_results.conditions: Only stationarity;no detailed balance needed. Metric cost comparison,not entrywise matrix domination;mean S=t and zero-step endpoint included.

seven_named_results.statement: Real-linear interleaving Re/Im map has norm distortion at most sqrt2;N2(complex l1)<=12sqrt42,energy square6048.
seven_named_results.conditions: Pull back real constructor;no direct coordinatewise complex median or same3024 constant claimed.

seven_named_results.statement: There exists universal unspecified finite K:for every real Hilbert H,any subset S and every Lipschitz f:S->real l1,there exists F:H->l1 extending f with LipF<=K Lipf.
seven_named_results.conditions: Uses MN13Cor1.13 plus Hilbert Markov type2=1,l1=c0* dual and main cotype. No effective extension constructor or explicit K=12sqrt21.
